d: Short, choppy chestnut brown hair with uneven bangs and a messy texture. Large, wide-eyed amber eyes with a soft, neutral expression on a youthful, adolescent face. A slender build, wearing a white short-sleeved sailor-style top with blue trim and a red necktie, paired with a pleated blue mini-skirt with white horizontal stripes at the hem.
